generated.details: In the middle plane left of the laptop, folded reading glasses rest beside it on the desk: two clear lenses joined by a slim dark bridge, with hinged temples folded behind the rims.
At the far-right rear of the desktop, a compact houseplant has leafy stems emerging from soil inside a cream ceramic pot with a stable flat base.
In the far-left background, relaxed ivory linen curtains hang from a rod in loose vertical folds, their hems falling beside the window.
